jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software. Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person. We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer- AI Platform
jobs.description_text: As a Staff Software Engineer on Aledade's AI Core Platform team, you will help build and operate the shared infrastructure that enables applications and AI agents across Aledade to securely and reliably access foundation models. You will work on the platform capabilities behind model access, including model gateways, cloud AI services, provider integrations, routing and fallback, usage controls, observability, reliability, and model governance. We’re looking for engineers who think beyond implementing individual features and consider the full lifecycle of production platform systems: architecture, scalability, failure modes, security, observability, operational readiness, cost, and developer experience. You will help evolve the platform as AI adoption grows across Aledade, building reusable and self-service capabilities rather than one-off solutions. You will work closely with engineers, product partners, security, infrastructure teams, and teams building AI applications and agents. Successful engineers in this role are comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, making pragmatic technical decisions, and building secure, maintainable, observable, and resilient systems.

jobs.description_text: Job Description The Account Managers are responsible for working directly with our customers to ensure full, continuous satisfaction with our solutions and services are met. The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. jobs.title: 1st Vice President, Compliance (OFS)
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The 1st Vice President, Compliance for CIM is responsible for supporting the CCO of CIM and a CIM affiliate, OFS Management (“OFS”), in ensuring that OFS maintains a compliance program reasonably designed to comply with applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations. The 1st VP, Compliance is responsible for the day-to-day management of the OFS compliance program, including oversight of a team of two compliance professionals. The 1st VP, Compliance assists the CCO of OFS-managed registered investment companies in maintaining their compliance programs, including their 38a-1 manuals and reports to the relevant boards, with the expectation that the 1st VP, Compliance assumes the role of CCO of at least one of the investment companies. The 1st VP, Compliance is also committed to the highest ethical standards and constant reinforcement of CIM’s and OFS’ uncompromising culture of compliance.

jobs.title: Associate, Global Consultant Relations
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: CIM Group is a private alternatives asset manager with 30-years of experience and approximately $32 billion in assets under management. Our expertise spans private equity and credit investments across real estate and infrastructure, offering a range of funds across the risk-return spectrum as well as customized client solutions. The Institutional Client Group (ICG) builds and maintains relationships with institutional investors and intermediaries globally. ICG includes regional institutional sales teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC—primarily serving pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and endowments—as well as the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), which serves major insurance companies and banks, and Global Consultant Relations (GCR), which works with investment consultants, OCIO providers, and other asset managers. ICG is seeking an Institutional Client Associate to join the Global Consultant Relations (GCR) team. This role works alongside senior team members, contributes to key fundraising initiatives, and offers direct exposure to some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutional investors and intermediaries. As a visible member of a collaborative, high-performing team, the successful candidate will gain hands-on experience, develop critical skills, and build a strong foundation for a successful career at a respected and growing investment firm. This position is based at our headquarters in Los Angeles.
